description: A mapped fixture window creates a window-backed dock row, but the current harness cannot create or remove that fixture during capture.

not_verified.reason: The negative control removes actions but leaves fixture_windows enabled, so the fixture row, its displayName "Fixture 0", and its window-child state all survive. Proving the row appeared requires a fixture-toggle action that maps a window after an earlier frame, which the harness does not have.
